lessonsIntro: We have not confirmed a surf school that teaches on Filey Bay; Scarborough Surf School is a short drive north at Cayton Bay.

text: Filey Bay is a five-mile sweep of sand with Filey Brigg at its northern end. North Yorkshire Council lists surfing among the activities here and provides a lifeguard service, but we could not find a surf school that runs lessons on this beach. The nearest confirmed school is Scarborough Surf School at Cayton Bay, a few miles north.

If you surf Filey on your own, stay in the lifeguarded area in season, keep away from the rocks around the Brigg, and check the forecast and tides before you go. Beginners will learn faster, and more safely, by booking a lesson at Cayton Bay or Scarborough first.

text: The beaches on this stretch are mostly sandy beach breaks, so a long foam board is the right start, moving on to a hard mini-mal or longboard as you improve. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm wetsuits because the North Sea stays cold, and adds boots, gloves and hoods for the cooler months.
